description: Per-subscriber target prices for Espresso Deal Alerts. When a tracked product's current price falls to or below a subscriber's target, alert_drops.py emits ONE target-hit alert for that subscriber through the same Telegram digest / email-outbox path as price-drop alerts, and records the hit in alert-state.json so the same (subscriber, product, target) is never announced twice. This file ships EMPTY of real subscribers: targets are added by the site owner as subscribers register them.

schema.targets: array of target objects (may be empty)
schema.targets[].channel: delivery channel label (string, required) — currently 'telegram' or 'email'; alerts ride the shared digest/outbox path and name the subscriber + channel
schema.targets[].slug: product slug (string, required) — must match a slug in tracker/products.json, e.g. 'urnex-dezcal-descaler-3-pack'
schema.targets[].subscriber: stable subscriber id (string, required) — e.g. an email address or a short handle the owner can map to a person
schema.targets[].target_price: target price in the product's listed currency (number > 0, required) — USD for US retailers, CAD for iDrinkCoffee; no currency conversion is applied
